title: Kubernetes Resource
description: JSON Schema for Kubernetes resource objects including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Namespaces, and Nodes. Covers the core API group (v1) and apps/v1 group resources used to define and manage containerized workloads.

apiVersion.description: API version identifying the schema and group for this resource. Examples: v1 for core resources, apps/v1 for Deployments, rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1 for RBAC resources.

kind.description: Resource type identifier. Determines which schema the spec and status fields follow.

spec.description: Specification of the desired state of the resource. The structure depends on the resource kind.

status.description: Most recently observed status of the resource. Populated by the system and read-only.

ObjectMeta.description: Standard Kubernetes object metadata present on all persistent resources. Contains identification, versioning, labels, annotations, and ownership information.

name.description: Unique name of the object within the namespace (or cluster, for cluster-scoped resources). Must be a valid DNS subdomain.

generateName.description: Prefix for server-generated unique names. Used when name is not specified.

namespace.description: Namespace that scopes the resource name. Only applies to namespaced resources. Defaults to 'default'.

uid.description: Unique identifier generated by the server upon resource creation. Immutable for the lifetime of the object.

resourceVersion.description: Opaque string identifying the server-side version of the object. Used for optimistic concurrency and watch operations.

generation.description: Sequence number for the desired state of the object. Incremented when the spec changes.

creationTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the object was created.

deletionTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the object will be deleted. Present when graceful deletion has been requested.

deletionGracePeriodSeconds.description: Number of seconds until the object is forcefully terminated during graceful deletion.

labels.description: Map of string key-value pairs used to organize and identify resources. Queryable via label selectors.

annotations.description: Map of non-identifying metadata. Arbitrary data that tools and libraries may attach to objects.

ownerReferences.description: List of owning resources that manage this object's lifecycle via garbage collection.

finalizers.description: List of finalizers that must be empty before the object is deleted from storage. Set by controllers to delay deletion.

OwnerReference.description: Reference to an owning resource. Used by garbage collection to clean up owned resources when the owner is deleted.

apiVersion.description: API version of the owning resource.

controller.description: If true, this reference points to the managing controller.

blockOwnerDeletion.description: If true, the owner cannot be deleted until this object is removed.

PodSpec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of a pod, including containers, volumes, scheduling constraints, and restart policy.

containers.description: List of containers to run in the pod. At least one container is required.

initContainers.description: List of init containers that run and complete before the app containers start.

volumes.description: List of volumes that can be mounted by containers in the pod.

restartPolicy.description: Restart policy for all containers. Defaults to Always.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Duration in seconds for graceful termination before SIGKILL. Defaults to 30.

serviceAccountName.description: Name of the service account for API access token projection.

nodeName.description: Node to schedule the pod on, bypassing the scheduler.

nodeSelector.description: Label key-value pairs that the node must match for scheduling.

hostNetwork.description: Whether the pod uses the host's network namespace. Defaults to false.

dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy for the pod. Defaults to ClusterFirst.

Container.description: A container definition specifying the image, command, resource requirements, ports, environment variables, and volume mounts for a single container running in a pod.

name.description: Unique name of the container within the pod. Used to reference the container in logs, exec, and port-forward.

image.description: Container image name in the format [registry/][repository/]name[:tag|@digest].

command.description: Entrypoint command. Overrides the ENTRYPOINT in the container image.

args.description: Arguments to the entrypoint. Overrides the CMD in the container image.

workingDir.description: Working directory in the container. Defaults to the image's working directory.

ports.description: List of ports to expose from the container for documentation and service selection.

env.description: List of environment variables to set in the container.

volumeMounts.description: Pod volumes to mount into the container's filesystem.

imagePullPolicy.description: When to pull the container image. Defaults to Always for :latest tag, IfNotPresent otherwise.

ContainerPort.description: A network port exposed by the container.

name.description: Optional name for the port, referenced by services and NetworkPolicies.

containerPort.description: Port number to expose on the container's IP address.

hostIP.description: Host IP to bind the external port to.

hostPort.description: Port to expose on the host. Binds this container port to the host. Avoid use when possible.

EnvVar.description: An environment variable present in a container.

name.description: Name of the environment variable. Must be a valid C identifier.

value.description: Literal string value for the environment variable. Mutually exclusive with valueFrom.

valueFrom.description: Source for the environment variable's value. Mutually exclusive with value.

configMapKeyRef.description: Reference to a ConfigMap key to populate the variable.

optional.description: Whether the ConfigMap or its key must exist.

secretKeyRef.description: Reference to a Secret key to populate the variable.

optional.description: Whether the Secret or its key must exist.

fieldRef.description: Reference to a field in the pod spec to populate the variable (e.g. metadata.name).

fieldPath.description: JSONPath expression for the field in the pod spec.

apiVersion.description: API version for the field schema.

ResourceRequirements.description: Compute resource requirements for a container, specifying CPU and memory requests and limits.

requests.description: Minimum resource amounts required for scheduling. The container is not placed on a node without these resources.

limits.description: Maximum resource amounts the container may use. CPU is throttled; memory violations cause OOM kills.

VolumeMount.description: Describes a volume mount from the pod's volume list into the container filesystem.

name.description: Name of the volume to mount. Must match a volume defined in the pod spec.

mountPath.description: Absolute path in the container where the volume should be mounted.

subPath.description: Path within the volume to mount. Defaults to the volume root.

readOnly.description: Whether the volume is mounted read-only. Defaults to false.

Probe.description: A probe describes how the kubelet checks the health of a container. Used for liveness (restart on failure), readiness (traffic routing), and startup (initial delay) probes.

httpGet.description: HTTP GET probe. Success is a response code in 200-399.

port.description: Port to probe. Can be an integer or a named port.

scheme.description: Scheme to use. Defaults to HTTP.

tcpSocket.description: TCP socket probe. Success is a successful connection.

exec.description: Execute a command in the container. Success is exit code 0.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before probing.

periodSeconds.description: Probe interval in seconds. Defaults to 10.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe times out. Defaults to 1.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the container is considered unhealthy. Defaults to 3.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes required after a failure to be considered healthy. Defaults to 1.

Volume.description: A volume that can be mounted into one or more containers in the pod. Supports many source types including ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVCs, emptyDir, and hostPath.

name.description: Volume name. Must be unique within the pod and match a VolumeMount name.

emptyDir.description: An empty directory scoped to the pod. Deleted when the pod is removed.

medium.description: Storage medium. Empty string uses node's default storage; Memory uses tmpfs RAM disk.

sizeLimit.description: Size limit for the emptyDir volume.

configMap.description: ConfigMap volume that mounts key-value pairs as files.

name.description: Name of the ConfigMap to mount.

defaultMode.description: File permission mode bits. Defaults to 0644.

secret.description: Secret volume that mounts secret data as files.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret to mount.

defaultMode.description: File permission mode bits. Defaults to 0644.

persistentVolumeClaim.description: PersistentVolumeClaim volume that mounts a claimed persistent volume.

claimName.description: Name of the PersistentVolumeClaim in the same namespace.

readOnly.description: Whether to mount as read-only. Defaults to false.

hostPath.description: HostPath volume that mounts a file or directory from the host node filesystem.

path.description: Path on the host to mount into the container.

type.description: Type of host path mount. Empty string performs no checks.

DeploymentSpec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of a Deployment, including replica count, pod selector, pod template, and rollout strategy.

replicas.description: Desired number of pod replicas. Defaults to 1.

template.description: Template for pods created by this deployment.

strategy.description: Update strategy for replacing existing pods.

type.description: Recreate terminates all pods before creating new ones. RollingUpdate incrementally replaces pods.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum pods that can be unavailable during update. Absolute or percentage.

maxSurge.description: Maximum pods that can be created above desired count during update.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old ReplicaSets to retain for rollback. Defaults to 10.

minReadySeconds.description: Minimum seconds a new pod must be ready before counting as available.

LabelSelector.description: A query over a set of resources by their labels, supporting equality-based and set-based requirements.

matchLabels.description: Key-value pairs that must all match labels on the target resource.

matchExpressions.description: Set-based label requirements applied with AND logic.

key.description: Label key the selector applies to.

operator.description: Relationship operator between the key and values.

values.description: Values for In/NotIn operators. Must be empty for Exists/DoesNotExist.

ServiceSpec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of a Service, including port mappings, pod selector, and service type for traffic routing.

type.description: Service exposure type. ClusterIP (default) is internal-only; NodePort adds a host port; LoadBalancer adds a cloud load balancer; ExternalName maps to a DNS name.

selector.description: Label selector identifying pods this service routes traffic to.

ports.description: Service port mappings from service port to pod target port.

clusterIP.description: Cluster-internal IP for the service. 'None' creates a headless service.

sessionAffinity.description: Session affinity type. ClientIP routes repeated requests from the same IP to the same pod.

externalName.description: External DNS name to which the service maps. Only for ExternalName type.

loadBalancerIP.description: IP to request for a LoadBalancer service when supported by the cloud provider.

ServicePort.description: Port mapping within a service, defining the protocol, service-facing port, and pod target port.

name.description: Port name. Required for multi-port services.

targetPort.description: Port on the pods to forward traffic to. Defaults to the value of port.

nodePort.description: Node-level port for NodePort/LoadBalancer services. Allocated automatically if not specified.
